utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got some tools I can bring to the Sunday repair drive at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus — I’ll keep it low-key and pass along that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and your tools are coming too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it got moved to Sunday at the community center—did anything else change?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s the main update I’ve got—just the new day and place. I’m checking our supplies now so we can see what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ve got the update that it’s Sunday at the community center now, so send me the list when you can and I’ll help sort the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep — I’ll check the list and send over what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What’s still left to fix, and do we have the supplies already?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, but I can check what still needs fixing at the Sunday repair drive and see what supplies are missing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’m confirming Sunday at the community center and I’ll check what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep the repair drive low-key and make sure we stay organized.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — yes, it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’d really appreciate any help lining up a few volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and see who can lend a hand on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Ira. Check the list when you can, and let me know what’s still needed for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by and check the supplies list, then I’ll let you know what we’re short on for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep, that’s right — Sunday at the community center now. I’ll check what still needs doing and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes — it’s Sunday at the community center now, and I’m trying to keep the drop-offs organized so nothing gets mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That sounds good — I can help keep the Sunday drop-offs sorted at the community center. I’ll work around the school schedule and bring whatever I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep — it’s Sunday at the community center now. If you want, I can help sort drop-off times or bring something along.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — keep it low-key, and I can help a little with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — what’s still left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries — the big thing is just getting the word out for Sunday at the community center, and I’m still trying to line up a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. If you can check what still needs doing, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’m still catching up, but I’ll check what’s left and report back.
